claims: Each of the six probes asserts the candidate result, the candidate behavior control and the 0.4.0 control that the spec's probe table states, and nothing in a probe passes vacuously (an empty list, a loop that never runs, an assertion on a constant).
Removing the four 0.3.0 controls removed no assertion about the candidate.
program_constants reads the constants of every exported program the probes pass it, for any model and mode the export supports, without running the program.
readme_commands fails when the packaged README stops listing a command the probe runs.
The corrected sentence in the PyRel block of docs/release-notes.md is true of 0.4.0 as evidence/RW2/controls-0.4.0.md measures it.
No probe reads a file of the source checkout where the spec says the input comes from the installed package.
